The '''occupation''' of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Siluria III]] occurred when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] subdued the local population. A [[Siluria III resistance|resistance]] movement opposed the local [[Governor/Legends|governor]], [[Quannith]], and he authorized attacks on the population.<ref name="TDC" />
